verdict.rationale: Appwrite's own docs refer to its official SDKs in several places. Functions can be triggered by SDK methods, and Messaging exposes createEmail/createSms/createPush through one SDK. The CLI's generate command builds a type-safe SDK tailored to the project's schema. Agent Skills and the MCP server exist specifically to keep AI agents' SDK calls accurate. Missing for 10: an enumeration of supported SDK languages/platforms, direct SDK reference or installation docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
